cohort: 142 women with pregestational diabetes mellitus (PGDM) treated with an insulin pump and sensor
finding: In women with PGDM treated with an insulin pump and sensor, SAP use during pregnancy was not associated with higher neonatal birth weight percentile or other adverse neonatal or pregnancy outcomes.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean section was higher in the SAP group, but this association was no longer statistically significant after adjusting for maternal age, BMI, and a history of severe hypoglycemic events before pregnancy.
birth_weight: median birth weight percentiles were similar (79 and 80) between neonates of mothers who did and did not use SAP
